Agricultural clinics
†*281. PROF. M.M. AGARWAL: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention
has been drawn towards the news-item
published in Hindustan of 23rd December,
2001 under the caption, "Prati varsh
paanch hazar krishi klinic kholne ka
faisla";
(b) if so, the details of the proposal;
(c) whether Government would also
provide agriculture related training to
farmers through these clinics; and
(d) if so, by when the said clinics
would start functioning in the country?
Another base station in Antarctica
*282. SHRI K.M. SAIFULLAH: Will
the Minister of OCEAN DEVELOP-
MENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether India propose to set up
another permanent base station in
Antarctica;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the target for setting up the station?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Retrenchment of SAIL employees
*283. SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
Will the Minister of STEEL be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of employees of SAIL
retired under Voluntary Retirement
Scheme during the last three years; and
(b) the amount, the undertaking is
expected to pay upto 31st March, 2003,
as retirement benefits to persons going for
retirement?
UGC grants for universities
*284. SHRI S. RAMACHANDRAN
PILLAI: Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of grants distributed by
the UGC during the last three years,
university-wise;
(b) whether it is a fact that UGC has
stopped giving funds to some universities;
(c) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor;
(d) whether any State Government has
given representation to the Ministry,
seeking restoration of UGC grants; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?

Regularisation of officials in SAIL
*285. DR. ARUN KUMAR SARMA:
Will the Minister of STEEL be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that SAIL
management recruited seven Research
Assistants and 33  non-executives on
temporary basis, during 1995—1997;
(b) if so, the details of those who have
been regularised after the initial
appointment, indicating the reasons for
non regularisation of the remaining
incumbants;
(c) whether it is a fact that
regularisation in respect of other
candidates was done, despite a pending
court case;
(d) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(e) if not, the facts thereof and by
which date the remaining incumbents
would be regularised?
Flood damage in Kerala
*286. SHRI N.K. PREMA-
CHANDRAN: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
extended special assistance towards flood
damage caused due to south-west
Monsoon, set in Kerala on 25th May,
2001;
(b) the estimated damage in different
sectors due to the flood havoc;
(c) the magnitude of damage assessed
by the Central Team;
(d) whether Government released the
assistance recommended by the Central
Team;
(e) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor; and
(f) whether Government would
consider releasing financial assistance
recommended therein?
Basic facilities in primary schools in
rural A.P.
*287. DR. DASARI NARAYANA
RAO: Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
conducted any survey to find out the
number of primary schools in rural Andhra
Pradesh which do not have school
buildings, class rooms and basic facilities
like benches, drinking water and toilets;
(b) if so, the findings thereof, district-
wise; and
(c) the remedial measures Government
propose to take in this regard?
Gauge conversion of Rupsa-
Bangriposi and Naupada-Gunupur
rail lines
*288. SHRI RAMACHANDRA
KHUNTIA: Will the Minister of
RAILWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that gauge
conversion work of Rupsa-Bangriposi and
Naupada-Gunupur in Orissa, sanctioned
in 1995-96 and 1997-98, is still
languishing;
(b) if so, the reasons for the delay in
taking up  the projects; and
(c) the fresh steps taken for expeditious
completion of work on these projects?
Conversion of Bhuj-Nalia rail line
*289. SHRI ANANTRAY DEV-
SHANKER DAVE: Will the Minister of
RAILWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether a survey for conversion of
Bhuj-Nalia rail line has been completed;
and

College of fisheries in Bihar
†2058. SHRIMATI KUM KUM RAI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government intend to open
a college of fisheries in Bihar for
development of pisciculture;
(b) if so, by when and the efforts made
by Government so far; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Plan for earthquake and cyclone in
Gujarat
2059. SHRI BRAHMAKUMAR
BHATT: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the entire Gujarat region is
prove to earthquake and cyclone;
(b) if so, whether Government have
made any survey in this regard;
(c) whether Government have made any
long-term planning to face such natural
disasters; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Boosting the farm sector
2060. SHRI SOLIPETA RAMA-
CHANDRA REDDY: Will the Minister
of AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have devised
concrete plans for implementation during
the Tenth Five Year Plan period, to boost
the farm sector;
(b) if so, the details of the plans;
(c) the expenditure expected to be
incurred during that period, State-wise and
year-wise; and
(d) the estimated increase in production,
State-wise and year-wise?
Dumping of milk products
2061. SHRI SOLIPETA RAMA-
CHANDRA REDDY: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that milk, milk-
powder and other milk-related products are
dumping in the country at cheaper rates,
which has caused less demand and loss to
milk producers of the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that milk

(d) if so, the details of steps being taken

Pisciculture schemes in Bihar
†2062. SHRIMATI KUM KUM RAI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
start pisciculture schemes in various water
logged areas and the rivers in Bihar;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Suicide by farmers
†2063. SHRI RAJNATH SINGH
'SURYA':
SHRI  JANESHWAR
MISHRA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to refer to answer to Unstarred
Question 1390, given in the Rajya Sabha
on the 3rd August, 2001 and state:
(a) whether it is a fact that tendency of
committing suicide by farmers is on the
increase all over the country due to non-
payment of loans as a result of crop losses
due to damage of crops and not getting
appropriate price;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the State-wise number of farmers
who committed suicide so far;
(d) the measures being taken by Govern-
ment to check this trend in future; an d
(e) whether Government would provide
concession to farmers in the rate of interest
on loans and special assistance?
Repealing the Milk and Milk Products
Order
2064. SHRI NANA DESHMUKH:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
repeal the Milk and Milk Products Order
which imposes restrictions on setting up
units, with large capacity, by the private
entrepreneurs;
(b) if so, what are Government's plans
in this regard; and
(c) what safeguards are being taken by
Government so that it is not misused?
ACPC workshop on MSP
2065. PROF. M. SANKARA-
LINGAM: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Commission for
Agricultural Costs and Prices organised a
workshop to determine the best way of
arriving at the Minimum Support Price;
(b) if so, what has been the outcome of
the workshop;
(c) the details of factors considered for
arriving at the best Minimum Support
Price;
(d) whether the workshop was
represented by all the farmers'
representatives from all the States; and
(e) if so, the details thereof and the
details of their contribution in the
workshop?
Constraints of land and water for
agricultural production
2066. SHRI SURESH PACHOURI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
